# ARM64-specific fixes applied in aesir_engine/loader/gguf.mojo (H041):
#  1. Mojo 1.1.0 removed InlineArray from std.collections -> fstat buffer is
#     now unsafe_alloc[UInt64](18) + zero-fill + unsafe_free (same 144 bytes).
#  2. struct stat ABI: st_mode lives at word 2 on aarch64, word 3 on x86_64;
#     the regular-file check ORs both slots (the other holds st_nlink).
# Zero behavior change on x86_64: existing suite test_gguf_parsing +
# test_ggml_type passes unmodified (run 2026-10-10 on the forge).
